name: Point-in-time Nifty 100 cross-sectional continuation experiment
membership_source: NSE / NSE Indices historical Nifty 100 constituent and reconstitution records
membership_rule: A symbol is eligible only between its recorded effective_from and effective_to dates.
survivorship_bias_policy: Current constituents must not be applied to the full historical sample.
selection_rule: Development data only; candidate frozen before chronological holdout and prospective testing.
liquidity_policy: Eligibility requires sufficient 5-minute coverage, plausible prices/volume, adequate recent activity, valid instrument mapping, and no unresolved data issue. Exact thresholds must be frozen before final backtest.
next_action: Acquire and validate point-in-time U1 membership and 5-minute coverage before evaluating candidate performance.
